title: README does not say where run artifacts are written
summary: The reporter ran the demo but could not locate the generated output reports. The current README explains setup and execution but does not document that artifacts are stored in `runs/<run-name>/` or describe the expected files. Adding a brief section on the artifact layout would improve clarity for users.
suggested_next_action: Update the README to include a short section describing the artifact layout and the location of generated reports.
